## Core Systems & Flagship Projects

1. **V.I.S.A.R. E.D.G.E.**
   - **Type**: Autonomous Distributed AI Operating Mesh & Desktop Flagship
   - **Description**: Autonomous AI operating mesh engineered for local desktop hardware. Powered by a pure Python asynchronous kernel featuring a 10.2µs Synapse IPC event bus, dynamic multi-agent swarms (4.82ms turnaround), quad cognitive brain modes (AUTO, FAST, AGENTIC, SUPERVISOR), 6-sense nervous system, 5-tier holographic memory, and unlimited Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration with two-tier human-in-the-loop safety gates.
   - **Web Hub**: https://visaredge.vercel.app/

2. **OrbitSpan**
   - **Type**: 3D Planetary Scale & Newtonian Gravity Simulation Engine
   - **Description**: Interactive 3D astrophysics engine calculating real-time planetary positions using NASA's VSOP87 analytical theory, computing true Newtonian gravitational pull on user body mass, and converting cosmic distances into human-scale physical benchmarks. Features Three.js R185 WebGL rendering and PWA offline caching.
   - **Web App**: https://orbitspan.vercel.app/
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/Orbit-Span

3. **Frame My Avatar**
   - **Type**: Client-Side Curved Text Avatar & Profile Frame Generator
   - **Description**: High-performance client-side avatar framing studio for crafting circular profile picture frames with customizable curved typography, 4 perimeter watermark accents (Ribbon Trim, Crown Halo, Upper Quadrant, Radial Contour), multi-ring status palettes (#OPENTOWORK, #HIRING), full URL state serialization, and 1080x1080 HD PNG exports with embedded tEXt metadata. 100% private with zero server uploads.
   - **Web App**: https://framemyavatar.vercel.app/
   - **Codebase**: Proprietary / Closed Source

4. **Git Uncommitted Scanner (scanrepos)**
   - **Type**: Cross-Platform CLI & Interactive TUI Utility (PyPI Package)
   - **Description**: High-speed utility that recursively deep-scans directories to instantly locate Git repositories with pending uncommitted changes, untracked files, and unstaged modifications. Features an interactive Neon-Cyan Textual terminal UI and Rich progress tables.
   - **PyPI Package**: https://pypi.org/project/git-uncommitted-scanner/
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/git-uncommitted-scanner

5. **FormEase**
   - **Type**: Zero-Upload Client-Side Document & Exam Photo Formatter
   - **Description**: Privacy-first, 100% browser-based photo, signature, and document formatter & compressor engineered for government, visa, and entrance exam portals (UPSC, SSC, State PSC). Executes all image resampling, binary size targeting, and aspect fitting locally in browser memory without external server uploads.
   - **Web App**: https://formease.deployxa.online/
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/FormEase

6. **NetSage AI**
   - **Type**: Cisco-AICTE VIP 2026 AI-Assisted Network Troubleshooter
   - **Description**: Dual-engine hybrid network diagnostic platform built for the Cisco-AICTE Virtual Internship Program (VIP 2026) at Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology & Sciences (GGITS). Blends a deterministic rule checker (26 regex parsers) with context-constrained LLM diagnostics and an interactive Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Streamlit review portal for NOC engineers.
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/DevanshSharma-GGITS-AI

7. **VISAR Edge Wake Word Model**
   - **Type**: Offline Neural Wake-Word Engine for Indian Phonetics
   - **Description**: Custom offline neural wake-word detection engine fine-tuned for Indian phonetics (Devanagari "वि-सार" / "Vee-saar"). Convolved with MIT Room Impulse Responses (RIRs) and calibrated against 96 real-world microphone telemetry samples to achieve 80.4% accuracy, 61.2% recall, and low false positive rate (~0.35/hr). Exports runtime ONNX and TFLite graphs with weights on Hugging Face.
   - **Model Weights**: https://huggingface.co/RootDeveloperDS/Visar_OpenWakeWord_Model
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/VISAR_OpenWakeWord_Model_Train

8. **J.A.R.V.I.S. (Mark 1 → 21)**
   - **Type**: Voice-Enabled AI Assistant Ecosystem
   - **Description**: Comprehensive voice-enabled AI assistant executing deep OS-level commands, system automation, and conversational AI integrations across 21 iterations.
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/J.A.R.V.I.S.

9. **VISAR Edge Mobile**
   - **Type**: Native Android HUD & PC Telemetry Daemon
   - **Description**: Remote control ecosystem with native Android Jetpack Compose client, 60Hz holographic trackpad, and Python PC companion daemon for real-time hardware telemetry and zero-latency audio pipelines.

10. **VISAR Intel**
    - **Type**: PWA Current Affairs & UPSC Distillation Engine
    - **Description**: High-performance current affairs PWA with automated substring search, Gemini AI MCQ generators, and persistent layout architecture.
    - **Web App**: https://visarintel.vercel.app/

11. **Neon Notes**
    - **Type**: Zero-Trust Cyberpunk Workspace
    - **Description**: Cyberpunk note-taking application engineered with Next.js, Firebase Auth, and zero-trust session lifecycle management.
    - **Web App**: https://neon-notes.vercel.app/
